messages:
lina: follow-up to yesterday's RFC 12: can we nail down the "mini admit gate" contract? I want explicit inputs/outputs so infra can instrument it and product can read the fast-pass signal.

marc: yes. minimal contract idea: input = model artifact id + hw profile + seed; output = pass|fail + failure-reasons(short list) + short metrics blob (json url). keep it compact.

lina: exactly. metrics blob should include: seq-bucket breakdown, tokenization-diff-count, top1-stability, kv-roundtrip-ok, p95_ms. anything else?

tess: add "observability_hint" field that points to a short repro (cmdline) so SEs can reproduce locally. e.g., `./mini-bench --model $ID --seed 42 --case=long`

marc: +1. we should also define severity levels: hard-fail (tokenizer mismatch, kv mismatch) vs soft-warn (p95 degradation <= 1.15x, top1 90-98%). soft-warns route to a throttled canary rather than full block.

lina: good call. canary path: soft-warn -> canary cohort 1% traffic for 24h with golden monitors enabled; hard-fail -> quarantine and file for manual intake.

qa-bot: mini-bench:v2 triggered for artifact 0x9f4a at 2026-03-23T12:05:00Z. runtime 3m42s. result: soft-warn (p95 1.12x), top1-stability 96.2%. report: https://console.redwood/minibench/0x9f4a

tess: that's a nice example. infra: how will the gateway consume pass|fail? we need a stable header or route decision API.

infra-bot: proposed API: POST /admit-checks {artifact, hw, seed} -> 202 accepted + check_id. GET /admit-checks/{check_id} -> {status, result_blob_url}. will add auth scopes.

marc: ensure the API returns a short decision enum: `DECISION_FAST_PASS`, `DECISION_CANARY`, `DECISION_QUARANTINE`. keep human-readable reasons under `reasons` array.

lina: operational concerns: need golden rotation schedule (weekly), and a replay harness for failing models to run full bench automatically. also keep mini-bench eigenvectors (input set) in a small repo with PR reviews.

tess: on telemetry: include runner image tag, GPU type, CUDA/cuDNN versions, and random-seed so runs are debuggable. also log the exact tokenizer hash.

marc: about adapter deprecation: we should maintain compatibility shim for 30 days after removal, and expose a redirect map so old clients get clear 410 + migration link.

lina: security note: enterprise/private deployments sometimes cannot call our hosted admit service. require a local runner mode with the same contract and a `signed-proofs` field for audit when onboarding offline.

qa-bot: regression-alert: model 0x8b2c failed mini-bench hard-fail (tokenizer mismatch). ticket created: INT-4721.

tess: can we add a tiny golden delta check: if top1-stability drops > 8% -> immediate hard-fail. keeps us safe from big regressions.

marc: agreed. also add a heuristics whitelist for low-resource dev models (opt-in) to avoid noisy quarantines.

lina: next steps: i'll draft the Admit Gate OpenAPI spec + mini-bench proto and put both in a single PR. @marc @tess please review; I'll also schedule a 30m sync to walk through the contract. :calendar: 

infra-bot: scheduled meeting created: "Admit Gate contract walkthrough" 2026-03-25T16:00Z.

marc: one last question: what are SLOs for admit-check latency? goal is <6m end-to-end for async path; sync preflight should be <30s. confirm?

lina: yes. sync = tokenization + kv check <30s, async mini-bench capped at 6m. escalate if resource throttling exceeds 10% of runs.

tess: great, sounds actionable. I'll mock the short report for console UI next week.

lina: thanks all! adding followup tickets and the spec PR now.
